endpoint_contract.original_representation: algRep S iota lambda on the literal tensor product over Emb ell S of nablaSq C n (lambda e.res)
endpoint_contract.coefficient_scope: For every original c:Coef ell, construct c-prime:Coef ell with literal subalgebra inclusion c.O<=c-prime.O inside the same Qbar_ell.
endpoint_contract.coefficient_map: The exact specified iota restricted to c-prime.O; no continuity of iota assumed.
endpoint_contract.local_maps: Restrictions of the original continuous field embeddings j:F_v->Qbar_ell, with maximal ideal powers carried into the corresponding powers.
endpoint_contract.character_identity: chi(diag y)=iota(product_v product_i algPow(S(v),lowW(lambda,i),y_vi)), exactly the original finite-support product and reversed weight.
endpoint_contract.is_alg_wt_witness: The explicit complex tensor basis coordinate isomorphism B in WRP6 intertwines the constructed matrices with the unchanged original algRep.
endpoint_contract.positive_operator_normalization: Uses the original local uniformizers and antitone exponent tuples; the normalized entry is product_e phi_e(varpi_v)^Delta_e with every Delta_e>=0 and some Delta_e>0 outside column zero for the original z.
endpoint_contract.choice_order: Fix L, ell, n, V, S, iota, lambda and c; form one finite compositum and coefficient DVR c-prime; choose one saturated integral weight basis for each factor and one tensor reindexing with lowest coordinate zero. The witness R is then fixed before any depth or precision. Set c0=0; for every precision k choose c=k.
endpoint_contract.permitted_simplification: Only the existential actual-DVR wtRep endpoint is claimed. Saturated lattices, HP1-HP2, and the dense Gaussian cell replace the source generic-domain standard-monomial SqBasis proof. No identity with that auxiliary chosen basis is required or asserted.
